scenarios.name: Small order, good credit
scenarios.description: A city bike with lock and insurance. The credit check returns a score of 720.

scenarios.name: Large order, approved in review
scenarios.description: An e-cargo bike above 5,000 € goes to a manual review, which approves it.

scenarios.name: Bad credit
scenarios.description: The credit check returns 420, so no condition is true and the default flow rejects the order.

scenarios.name: Order total missing
scenarios.description: orderTotal is not set, so the condition fails and the token stops. Add it via Edit under Instance, then press ▶ on the gateway.
